name: my1-handover-lean-s0

fort.build: pool/dfpool build (private) or pool/dfpool build-public --task MY1 --seeds 2001,2002,2005 (public): embark the seed, the automation arm plays it 120 days with [ARTIFACTS:NO], quicksave at day 120 (pool/fort_in_container.sh my1)
fort.identity: world.sav bytes (bench/key.py): a day-120 fort is not reproducible run to run, so the pool builds it once, hashes it and reuses it for every submission

pool_note: Private pool (pool/README.md): `snapshot_pool_private` holds placeholders that `pool/dfpool stage` resolves to the season's sealed forts (scenarios/snapshots/<season>-<task>-p<i> under DFBENCH_SNAPSHOTS_DIR); the staged copy drops `snapshot` and replaces `snapshot_pool`. Without staging, the task runs on the public `snapshot_pool` below (competitors' local runs).
goal: You are taking over an established fortress partway through its first year. Run it for {days} days. Scored on how the fortress is doing (see SCORE): dwarves alive, drink and food kept in stock to the end, wellbeing, and beds and dining for everyone.
brief: An established fortress, about 120 days after its founding, with workshops, farms and stocks. Its previous overseer's standing orders and automation have been switched off. Its stores hold about two months of drink and food.
description: DRAFT (docs/HARNESS-CHALLENGE.md §4.1). Late-game management of an inherited fort, day 120 -> 336, on seed-built day-120 forts (no shipped save): a fresh TEMPERATE_SOIL embark played 120 days by the automation arm, then at hand-over scenarios/lua/handover.lua turns off its control-panel automation and cancels every repeating manager order. Stocks, buildings, farms and zones stay. Lean stock: scenarios/lua/trim_stocks.lua 60 then trims drink and food to ~60 days of consumption for the fort's citizens at hand-over (0.07 drink and 0.10 food per dwarf-day, measured on the noop arm of runs/local-my1-handover-2026-10-22; an assumption), so an unmanaged fort runs dry around day 60 of 216. The season-0 MY1 candidate; admitted only if noop fails clearly at n = 8 on the private pool.
provenance: Season-0 seed-built successor of scenarios/my1-handover.json (whose pool is 4 automation saves of fort_start_snapshot made by .github/workflows/phase0-my1.yml). Lean stock added for the noop-fails-cleanly requirement (runs/local-my1-handover-2026-10-22 README).
